projects.title: Watch-Linked Android Auto Reset
projects.description:
I need an Android service that hardens my phones and tablets by tying their safety to a Samsung Watch.

Core workflow  
• While the watch is paired and within 50 m (GPS), the device behaves normally.  
• If the watch travels beyond that radius, a countdown starts (length to be parameterised in settings). When the timer expires, the handset performs a full factory reset.  
• The same timer-then-reset sequence is triggered whenever the watch is powered off or its Bluetooth connection is deliberately severed.  
• A unique, user-set PIN must be entered on the system lock screen to cancel the reset once it has begun. No PIN, no mercy—reset proceeds.

Technical notes  
• Must run on Android 10 and above without root.  
• Should recognise any Samsung Watch that exposes standard Bluetooth LE/Galaxy Wearable APIs—no model restrictions.  
• Background service must survive reboots, battery-optimisation kills and Doze.  
• Reset must use the official Android Device Policy / Device Admin (or newer Device Owner) call so it cannot be blocked by factory UX.  
• Settings screen required for radius, countdown length, and PIN management.  
• Clean, well-commented Kotlin or Java code, ready for Play store review.

Deliverables  
1. Signed APK + source project  
2. Brief README covering setup, permissions, and how to grant device-admin / owner privileges  
3. One-page test report proving:  
   – distance trigger,  
   – watch-off trigger,  
   – PIN cancellation,  
   – successful wipe on fail.

projects.title: PDF Text Extraction to SQL
projects.description:

• A script (Python, Java, or similar) that reads each PDF, pulls out the complete text, and writes it into a table such as `pdf_text` with columns like `id`, `file_name`, `page_number`, and `text_block`.

projects.description:
Tracking & Measurement Specialist (Server-side GTM / Stape / Meta CAPI) – Contract

About us
Java Whiskers runs cat cafés in London (White City and Marylebone) and Sweden. Tickets are sold through Roller, which is embedded in an iframe on our site. We advertise on Meta, TikTok and Google Ads, and work with Awin affiliates.

The situation
In September we launched a new UK website with a new tracking setup: a GTM web container, a server-side GTM container on Stape, Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API, GA4 and Awin. Since the launch our UK sales have dropped from +6–16% year over year to −7–14%, and our ad platforms are receiving poor-quality signals. We’ve already completed an internal audit, documented every issue and fixed the most urgent ones. We now need an experienced specialist to finish the job, verify everything end to end and make sure our data can be trusted.

What’s already been found and partly fixed

Meta received placeholder or invalid email addresses (over 50% of server events) and mismatched purchase value/currency (88% of purchases). Hashing, validation and value mapping were fixed on 6 October and need verifying.
The share of purchases tracked by the browser pixel versus the server dropped to about 30%, because the pixel didn’t fire after cookie consent. This is partly fixed for Meta, but not yet for TikTok.
Event IDs for deduplication were unstable. This is fixed and needs verifying.

What we need you to do

Verify and complete

Verify the changes already made, using GTM preview (web and server), Meta Test Events and TikTok Events Manager.
Finish the remaining fixes:
TikTok pixel firing after consent
Duplicate page_view events from SPA history changes (GA4 shows around 15 page views per session)
Correct order value sent to Awin
Splitting add_to_cart from begin_checkout, which currently fire on the same Roller step
A domain allowlist in Meta Events Manager
Bring Meta Event Match Quality above 7 for purchases.

Fix attribution

Around 50% of GA4 revenue is “Unassigned” or “Direct”. The Roller checkout iframe grants consent automatically and starts new sessions. Work with Roller support and our web developer to fix cross-domain attribution and consent handling.
Investigate an anomaly on 7 October: GA4 engagement fell to 5%, Unassigned rose to 66%, and an unusual spike of low-quality Cross-network traffic came in.

Make it compliant (UK GDPR / PECR)

Make sure the server container only forwards data to Meta, TikTok and Awin when consent has been given.
Gate click-ID cookies (gclid, fbc, ttclid, Awin) and third-party scripts behind consent.
Remove PII from GA4.
Implement Consent Mode v2 correctly across our in-house cookie banner and the Roller iframe.

Document and hand over

Write clear documentation of the final setup.
Do a short handover session with our team.
Do a follow-up check 2–4 weeks after go-live.

Must have

Proven experience with server-side GTM, preferably hosted on Stape.
Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API, including deduplication, Event Match Quality and advanced matching.
GA4 and Consent Mode v2, with a solid understanding of how consent affects attribution.
Experience with third-party checkouts in iframes (Roller or similar booking or ticketing platforms) and cross-domain tracking.
Good knowledge of UK GDPR and PECR in a tracking context.
Methodical and well documented: you test in preview before you publish, and you explain what you changed and why.

Nice to have

Experience with Awin or other affiliate networks.
Experience with Google Ads enhanced conversions and offline conversion imports.

What you get from us

A full written audit with evidence, a step-by-step fix guide and documentation of every change made so far.
Access to GTM (web and server), Stape, GA4, Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads and Awin.
A fast, responsive point of contact.

Scope and timeline
We expect roughly 15–25 hours for the main work, followed by a short follow-up. We’d like to start as soon as possible.

How to apply
Please send us:

A short description of a similar server-side tracking project you’ve delivered, ideally with Meta CAPI and a third-party checkout.
How you would approach the Roller iframe consent and attribution problem.
Your hourly rate or a fixed-price estimate, and your availability.

projects.title: Business Development for Recruitment
projects.description:
# Recruitment Business Development Partner – Bring MNC/Corporate Hiring Clients

We are looking for experienced **Recruitment Business Development Partners / Client Acquisition Consultants** who can help us connect with **MNCs, IT companies, startups, consulting firms, and other organizations with ongoing recruitment requirements**.

This is a **performance-based partnership**, ideal for individuals or recruitment consultants who already have corporate connections and can generate genuine hiring requirements.

## What You Will Do

As our Recruitment Business Development Partner, your responsibilities will include:

* Identify and approach companies with active or upcoming hiring requirements.
* Generate new recruitment clients and establish business relationships.
* Connect with HR Managers, Talent Acquisition Heads, HRBPs, Recruitment Heads, Founders, and relevant decision-makers.
* Understand the client's hiring requirements, skill sets, experience levels, locations, budgets, and timelines.
* Introduce our recruitment organization and coordinate the onboarding of new clients.
* Obtain job requirements/JDs from clients and share them with our recruitment team.
* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding open positions and hiring progress.
* Follow up with clients for interview feedback, candidate status, offers, and joining updates.
* Help build long-term relationships with clients for repeat hiring requirements.
* Ensure that requirements shared are genuine and that the client has an actual hiring need.

## Our Recruitment Team Will Handle

Once a client/requisition is generated, our internal recruitment team can support the delivery process, including:

* Candidate sourcing
* Resume screening and validation
* Candidate coordination
* Initial screening
* Interview coordination
* Candidate follow-ups
* Offer and joining coordination
* Recruitment process tracking
* Client delivery support

You can therefore focus primarily on **client acquisition and relationship management**, while our recruitment team handles candidate delivery.

## Payment / Success Fee

This is a **success-based partnership**.

There is **no payment for simply generating a lead**. The partner earns a commission/success fee when a candidate successfully joins the client organization through the recruitment requirement generated by the partner.

The exact commission structure will be mutually agreed upon based on:

* Client type
* Hiring volume
* Position/skill level
* Recruitment fee received from the client
* Number of successful placements
* Payment terms agreed with the client

**Payment will be released after the candidate joins and after the applicable client payment/placement terms are fulfilled.**

## Ideal Partner Profile

We are particularly interested in people who have:

* Existing relationships with MNCs, IT companies, startups, or corporate HR teams.
* Experience in recruitment business development/client acquisition.
* Experience working with staffing/recruitment agencies.
* Access to HR/Talent Acquisition decision-makers.
* Understanding of IT and non-IT recruitment requirements.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to generate genuine job requirements rather than just candidate leads.
* Ability to build long-term client relationships.
* Previous experience in commission-based recruitment or staffing partnerships is a plus.

## Target Clients

We are interested in connecting with organizations hiring for roles such as:

* Software Engineering
* Java / .NET / Python
* Full Stack Development
* Data Engineering
* DevOps / Cloud
* AI / ML / Generative AI
* SAP
* Salesforce
* Testing / QA
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure
* Database Administration
* Business Analysis
* Project / Program Management
* Other IT and corporate roles

We are open to partners who can bring requirements from **MNCs, mid-size companies, startups, product companies, consulting organizations, and other genuine employers**.

## Why Partner With Us?

* Performance-based earning opportunity
* No fixed working hours
* Work remotely
* Focus on client acquisition while our team supports recruitment delivery
* Opportunity for recurring income from repeat client requirements
* Long-term partnership potential
* Multiple technology and non-technology hiring opportunities
* Suitable for independent recruiters, recruitment consultants, HR consultants, and staffing professionals

## Important

We are looking for **genuine business development/recruitment partners who can bring actual corporate hiring requirements**.

This is not a candidate-sourcing-only project. The primary objective is **client acquisition and generating recruitment mandates**.

If you already have relationships with HR/Talent Acquisition teams or have experience acquiring recruitment clients, please apply and tell us:

1. Your recruitment/business development experience
2. Types of clients you currently work with
3. Industries/companies you have access to
4. Your experience generating recruitment mandates
5. Your preferred success-fee/commission model
6. How you plan to generate new clients for us

We are interested in building a **long-term partnership**, where both sides benefit from successful placements and repeat business.
